title: Na Snehithuda – Nissy John, Prabhu Pammi Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీ స్వరం మధురము నా ప్రియుడా యేసయ్య
english: nee swaram madhuramu naa priyudaa yesayyaa

credits.Lyrics: Pammi Daniel, Divya David & Prabhu Pammi

intro: Na Snehithuda is the latest Hindi Christian song written by Pammi Daniel, Divya David & Prabhu Pammi, sung by Nissy John & Prabhu Pammi, music & produced by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer, music director, worship leader, Prabhu Pammi. This song was released on August 29, 2022 through Prabhu Pammi YouTube channel.
